dedupe_keys.name: arriving vessels gross and net tonnage by type of vessel and month mesaieed port

description: Arriving Vessels' Gross and Net Tonnage By Type of Vessel and Month Mesaieed Port is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents the number, gross tonnage, and net tonnage of vessels arriving at Mesaieed Port in Qatar, broken down monthly by vessel type for the year 2023. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 11 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are Maritime Transport, arriving vessels, type of vessel, vessel. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
